property_summary: For any caller and any balance, calling withdrawBalance() on the correct contract resets the caller's stored balance to 0 and reverts if the external send fails; the mutant that ignores send failures can leave userBalance unchanged for some inputs (i.e. it does not revert and may not preserve the invariant that failing sends revert the whole call), so there exist inputs where the observable behavior (whether withdrawBalance reverts and the mapping value) differs.
change_summary: Replace the revert() on failed call with an unconditional ignore of the failure, so withdrawal does not revert on failed send.
